description.en: Original Belosaepia-inspired internal-shell specimen only: a thick posterior body joins a long gently curved posterior prong and broad thin anterior shield/deck through one continuous shell volume. Relative thickness and outward flare are readable; microscopic chambers, soft cuttlefish, arms and inferred living body proportions are omitted. Nominal11cm, palette and presentation are artistic, not a copied fossil or exact species measurement.
